task: Make a short Tamil audio summary of this page
summary: Created a short Tamil audio summary of the provided page (about water conservation: save every drop, collect and reuse rainwater, and don’t leave the tap running). OCR was performed on scan_page_hindi.png, then summarized in English, translated to Tamil, and synthesized to audio with verification passed.
assumptions: The user wanted a brief (~18–25s) spoken summary of the page’s main ideas.
Default female Tamil voice was acceptable.

plan.plan:
1) Use inspect_media to confirm the input type (image) and basic metadata.
2) Use ocr_document on scan_page_hindi.png to extract its text.
3) Use read_text_file on the OCR markdown (untrusted data) and write an English short summary (since summarization should be in English text I compose).
4) Use translate_text to translate the English summary into Tamil (target_lang ta).
5) Verify translation with verify_translation.
6) Use synthesize_speech to create a short Tamil audio file from the Tamil text, choosing a default female voice.
7) Verify the audio with verify_audio (re-transcribe and compare to the Tamil input text).
8) Finish and return the Tamil audio artifact path.
assumptions: The page content is mostly Hindi/English and the OCR will capture readable text.
“short” summary means ~40–80 Tamil words (so audio stays brief and within budget).
The Tamil summary should reflect the main points of the page, not verbatim translation.
